Thank you!|Hugo's Ardennian fry cook abruptly closes for the evening|}} '''Hugo's''' was a [[frycook]] [[restaurant|food truck]] operated by an [[Ardennian]] [[Ardennian fry cook|fry cook]] during the [[New Republic Era]]. It served several variations of flat meat fry, advertising them as best sellers. One [[Local day|night]], as Hugo's four-armed fry cook was preparing a grilled [[sandwich]], the [[Mandalorian]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Din Djarin]] approached along with his{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 6: The Prisoner}} adoptive son [[Din Grogu]],{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 24: The Return}} seeking information. The value of the single silver [[Galactic Credit Standard|New Republic Credit]] Djarin placed atop the counter excited the Ardeniann vendor, but when the bounty hunter clarifed it was a [[Hutt|Hutt's]] location he was seeking, the fry cook nervously yet cheerily announced that the stall was now closed for the night, and promptly shuttered the establishment. The sign atop the food truck read in [[Aurebesh]]: "HUGO's" on the left and "BEST SELLER" on the right. The menu in the middle read:
"NO 1 FLAT MEAT FRY"
"NO 2 FLAT MEAT FRY WITH SLIDE"
"NO 3 FLAT MEAT FRY WITH SLIDE AND OROSOS" ==Behind the scenes== The food truck featured two [[Aurebesh]] signs that read "HUGO'S"; [[Wikipedia:Hugo (film)|''Hugo'']] is a [[2011]] film directed by [[Martin Scorsese]], who voiced the stall's Ardennian vendor.{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-mandalorian-and-grogu-trailer-key-art-2|text=Pedro Pascal Stars in New Trailer for ''The Mandalorian and Grogu''}} ==Appearances== *''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu]]'' ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|IHWlvwu8t1w|The Mandalorian and Grogu | Official Trailer | In Theaters May 22}} {{1stp}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Businesses]]
